title: Meta looks to raise up to $95 billion from stock sales to fund its huge AI build-out
content:
Meta is tapping investors for up to $95 billion to fund its huge AI build-out.
The tech giant said in a Monday filing that it has launched about $35 billion in equity offerings, comprising around $22.5 billion of Class A common stock, and $12.5 billion in depositary shares representing preferred stock.
The parent company of Facebook, WhatsApp, and Instagram also said it was planning a $60 billion at-the-market offering once its Class C shares begin trading in the first quarter of 2027.
In an at-the-market offering, a company sells shares gradually into the market at the prevailing market price, instead of as a large block at a fixed price.
Meta said last week that it would introduce the new share class to help founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg access the liquidity he may need to pay California's proposed wealth tax without having to sell existing shares and erode his voting control over the company.
"AI is creating significant opportunities for Meta across its core business and new products and services," the company said in a press release.
"Meta is investing to expand the infrastructure and compute capacity needed to support these opportunities and to bring personal superintelligence to billions of people and businesses," it added.
Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom have each expressed an interest in buying up to $5 billion of the common stock being offered, but those indications aren't binding, so they might buy more or less, Meta said.
Meta stock swung during Monday's premarket from 2% in the green to 0.4% in the red.
Meta is spending heavily on AI infrastructure as it develops consumer AI products and pursues Mark Zuckerberg’s goal of "personal superintelligence."
The company said it expects to incur $135 billion to $145 billion of capital expenditures this year. It highlighted $97 billion of operating cash flow for the first nine months of this year, and the roughly $82 billion of cash and other liquid assets it held at the end of September.
Meta's revenue jumped by 26% to around $65 billion last quarter, but its operating income shrank by 37% to $13 billion as costs surged from about $31 billion to $52 billion.

report.summary: Meta拟售股融资至多950亿美元加码AI
report.background: 生成式AI军备竞赛推高算力与数据中心投入，Meta将“个人超级智能”列为目标，资本开支升至千亿美元级。其收入仍增长，但成本激增压缩营业利润，现金流承压。此次通过股权与ATM发行融资，是在不显著加杠杆前提下补充AI基建资金；同时新设C类股也服务于扎克伯格应对加州拟议财富税的流动性安排，反映巨头AI投入与治理、监管交织。
key_points: 融资分两步：先发行约350亿美元股权，包括225亿美元A类普通股和125亿美元优先股存托凭证；2027年一季度C类股交易后再启动最高600亿美元ATM发行，合计至多950亿美元。
资金用途指向AI基础设施与算力扩张。Meta称AI在核心业务和新产品中带来重大机会，要支持“个人超级智能”惠及数十亿人和企业。
财务压力明显：今年资本开支预计1350亿至1450亿美元；上季营收增26%至约650亿美元，但营业利润降37%至130亿美元，成本从310亿升至520亿美元。
英伟达、AMD、博通各表示有意认购至多50亿美元普通股，但不具约束力，可能多买或少买，显示芯片供应商与Meta AI扩张深度绑定。
新设C类股助扎克伯格获得流动性，以应对加州拟议财富税，同时避免出售现有股份稀释投票控制权，融资安排兼具AI投入与公司治理目的。
report.impact: 对AI行业，Meta千亿美元级融资与资本开支将加剧算力军备竞赛，强化“资本+芯片+云”壁垒，并可能带动其他巨头跟进股权融资。对开发者，算力供给和模型能力可能提升，但生态更集中于巨头，API与平台依赖风险上升。对普通用户，个人超级智能产品会加速落地，体验提升的同时，广告、隐私与数据使用争议也可能扩大。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注Meta的Llama系列与PyTorch生态；部署侧可试vLLM、Hugging Face Transformers、Ollama；融资与资本开支细节可查SEC EDGAR的8-K、招股书和公司财报。
